reviewContext.issueReference: none; runtime workflowInput of opus-terra-design-and-implement-review-loop-session-780 (continuation of blocked session 776 and of session 778, which failed at dispatch-plans because tsh-s778-dispatch.json had no acceptanceCriteria) is authoritative
reviewContext.userProblem: nodetto has no spreadsheet-style element. Users need a first-class table.sheet element (typed columns, rows, header row, per-column widths, per-row heights, cell text) that displays and edits like an Excel sheet or a Notion table, distinct from the ERD erd.table element.
requiredOutcomes: table.sheet is created from the toolbox (default 3x3), renders header plus grid with typed cells in light and dark themes, and its bounds equal the sum of column widths and row heights.
In-place cell editing with Enter, Tab, Shift+Tab, Escape and arrow keys; rows and columns can be added, deleted, renamed, retyped and resized; each edit is one undo step.
Pasting TSV fills a range and grows the table; copying a range yields TSV.
The inspector edits header row, striping and column properties.
Validation rejects duplicate ids, unknown column keys, type mismatches and limit violations with table.* issue codes; valid tables round-trip through JSONL unchanged.
SVG and PNG export render the table like the canvas, verified by SVG output tests.
The CLI creates tables from inline data and CSV/TSV, edits cells, lints and exports them; docs/cli.md and help text describe it.
docs/editing.md documents the shape and design-docs/specs/design-table-sheet.md exists.
mise run lint, bun run typecheck, the TS test suites, and the CLI and desktop builds pass; erd.table behavior is unchanged.
nonGoals: Formulas, sorting, filtering, merged cells, frozen panes, multi-line cell layout.
New Command kinds (the private Worker authoring-discovery.ts is exhaustive over Command kinds).
Any change to erd.table schema, behavior, rendering or tests, or to packages/core/src/commands.ts.
Server code, auth, secrets or deployment config in this public repository.
Redesigning or re-splitting the plans committed at fc2ef3b.
constraints: Follow AGENTS.md; no emojis; cargo commands use CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true.
Do not redesign: reuse design-docs/specs/design-table-sheet.md, design-docs/user-qa/table-sheet.md and the pinned contracts in impl-plans/active/tsh-00-overview.md.
Wave-1 plans do not import each other at runtime; the only cross-plan reference is the type-only import of ./types.ts from tsh-01d-values.
Every verification command exits 0 and runs at least one test; plans reference only test files they create or that already exist; per-plan verification uses no directory filters.
Terra workers implement every owned file before reporting and run their plan's verification at the end.

All plans share one branch and working directory: workers run no state-changing git commands, freshly read each file before editing, record pre/post git hash-object per edit in their own progress log, edit only their writePaths and own progress file, and keep evidence under tmp/tsh-s780/<planId>/ untracked. Drift in a file the worker does not own is reported, not repaired; repair is serial after the wave joins.
mise run test-cli (tsh-08) gets up to 3 attempts under load, each logged in attempt-<n>/; deadlines are never relaxed; skipped native tests count as failures.
Tests use only self-authored neutral data.

intentionalTradeoffs: tsh-01a-ir owns IR-internal registration, the core table-sheet barrel and one barrel line in core index.ts (design section 11).
tsh-01c, tsh-01d and tsh-04a exceed the ~150-line target; accepted because each owns at most 4 source files.
Export text truncation uses estimated text widths, so ellipsis points may differ slightly from the browser.
The cell editor is single-line; newlines reach text cells only through paste or the CLI.
Concurrent edits to the same cell are last writer wins.
supportedEdgeCases: Paste larger than the table grows rows and columns up to limits (100 columns, 1000 rows) and reports table.limit beyond them.
Paste coerces values to column types; select columns gain new options.
Deleting the last remaining column is refused (table.lastColumn).
Dates are validated as real YYYY-MM-DD calendar dates including leap years.
CSV parsing follows RFC 4180 with an optional UTF-8 BOM.
Escape while editing cancels with no history entry.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Formulas, sorting, filtering, merged cells and frozen panes.
Tauri WKWebView clipboard permission behavior beyond what tsh-08 observes.
residualRisks: Superseded tsh-01-model.md, tsh-04-cell-editing.md and tsh-s776-dispatch.json stay in impl-plans/active until plan-archive and must not be dispatched.

CLI deadline flakiness under load: test-cli gets up to 3 attempts.
